From 3f487be81292702a59ea9dbc4088b3360a50e837 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Guangshuo Li <lgs201920130244@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 18:56:19 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] btrfs: fix double free in create_space_info() error path

When kobject_init_and_add() fails, the call chain is:

create_space_info()
-> btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()
-> kobject_init_and_add()
-> failure
-> kobject_put(&space_info->kobj)
-> space_info_release()
-> kfree(space_info)

Then control returns to create_space_info():

btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() returns error
-> goto out_free
-> kfree(space_info)

This causes a double free.

Keep the direct kfree(space_info) for the earlier failure path, but
after btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() has called kobject_put(), let
the kobject release callback handle the cleanup.

Fixes: a11224a016d6d ("btrfs: fix memory leaks in create_space_info() error paths")
CC: stable@vger.kernel.org # 6.19+
Reviewed-by: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: Guangshuo Li <lgs201920130244@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

diff --git a/fs/btrfs/space-info.c b/fs/btrfs/space-info.c
index 8278e7998bc9..f0436eea1544 100644
--- a/fs/btrfs/space-info.c
+++ b/fs/btrfs/space-info.c
@@ -320,7 +320,7 @@ static int create_space_info(struct btrfs_fs_info *info, u64 flags)
 
 	ret = btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type(space_info);
 	if (ret)
-		goto out_free;
+		return ret;
 
 	list_add(&space_info->list, &info->space_info);
 	if (flags & BTRFS_BLOCK_GROUP_DATA)
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

### Files Modified
- **`fs/btrfs/space-info.c`** (single file)

### Modifications
In the function `create_space_info()`, the error handling path when `btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()` fails was changed:

- **Before:** `goto out_free;`  
  This jumped to a label that called `kfree(space_info)`.

- **After:** `return ret;`  
  This directly returns the error code without going through the `out_free` label.

### Relationships
- The bug was a **double free** of `space_info`: when `kobject_init_and_add()` fails inside `btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()`, the code already releases the memory via `kobject_put()` → `space_info_release()` → `kfree(space_info)`. After returning, the previous code would then execute the `out_free` path and call `kfree(space_info)` again.
- The fix removes the duplicate free by exiting immediately upon failure, leaving cleanup to the kobject release callback. The earlier `out_free` path (for other failure points prior to the kobject call) remains unchanged.
